text:
Iris (Growth): Need a partner-friendly embed kit for the benchmark launch. Small, easy to drop into partner emails/pages. Deadline: Fri EOD.

Jun (Design): Quick checklist? co-brand rules? sizes?

Iris (Growth): Essentials only: 600x200 partner banner (png/svg), 300x250 ad tile, 600x600 micro-GIF (2s), co-brand badge SVG, 1-page PDF one-sheet. Include EN copy + 2 CTAs.

Maya P.: Key stat to surface: 'avg latency: 42ms/token' + short cost line '~2x cheaper vs baseline'. Tone: factual, not hyperbolic.

Sam O.: Brand constraints: primary blue + neutrals; no neon. Provide white-bg and transparent versions. Add safe clearspace rules for badges.

Jun (Design): Deliverables: png/svg @1x/@2x, gif/mp4 for motion, figma file, README with color tokens and export names. Naming: partner-embed-YYYYMMDD-<asset>-v1.

assets-bot: Uploaded starter file https://www.figma.com/file/placeholder/partner-embed-kit. Use branch 'partner-embeds'. :rocket:

Iris (Growth): Perfect. If any blocker, ping me directly. Keep thread replies short.
